## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; all checks pass
- [ ] User/admin documentation updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] `project.manifest.json` and contracts updated if modules changed
- [ ] No physical deletion of business data (soft delete only)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in code, logs or screenshots
